This has been muted on branch main

**Mute Reasons:**
- [main] 3 failures in test testMoveToRolloverStep (2.1% fail rate in 146 executions)

**Build Scans:**
- [elasticsearch-intake #24083 / part5](https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/hsugg77yuknoq)
- [elasticsearch-periodic-platform-support #8802 / almalinux-8-aarch64_checkpart5_platform-support-arm](https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/2z3i4ehhxlfjm)
- [elasticsearch-pull-request #75749 / part-5](https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/3bs4w3bkt7uqg)

This test failure, #129490, #129491, and #129510, are all caused by #129366. In that PR, we obtain a `ProjectState` by using the `Index` to look up the project from the cluster state. However, when an index is deleted, that statement fails. Since we have no guaranteed way of determining which project a deleted index was from, we need to explicitly pass the `ProjectID` in the `IndexLifecycleClusterStateUpdateTask`s. This failure was tripping this assertion: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/e4371631484abb8f94b1d0d3528d2a96c0241a22/x-pack/plugin/ilm/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/ilm/MoveToErrorStepUpdateTask.java#L106
which shouldn't be directly breaking things in production clusters, but in this case it _is_ a bug and not a feature. I'll open a PR to address these tests.

Since #129366 we obtain a `ProjectState` by using the `Index` to look up the project from the cluster state. However, when an index is deleted, that statement fails. Since we have no guaranteed way of determining which project a deleted index was from, we need to explicitly pass the `ProjectID` in the `IndexLifecycleClusterStateUpdateTask`s.
